tasks.short: Create solar electrical diagrams and schedules

steps.what: Define circuit topology, connection details and panel schedule content from the solar design
Create diagrams and panel schedules using the electrical CAD environment
Check electrical connectivity, ratings and drawing consistency before accepting the exact revision

tasks.design: Configure native symbols, connection tables and schedule generation in the electrical CAD environment {OTHER}. The engineer supplies the actual circuit decisions and checks the generated set before accepting it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated symbol placement and schedule transcription duplicated engineering decisions already made.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked drawings and schedules can render explicit circuit records.
tasks.still_hard: A tidy diagram can embody incorrect protection or connection design.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether the electrical representation matches the intended safe system.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated drawing construction; engineering design and approval rights stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Preserve connection identity and revision consistency.

evidence.claim: Native electrical CAD templates and linked schedules are model knowledge; no digest case measures solar drawing labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is drawing and schedule production from an existing engineering design; electrical sizing and site installation are separate.

In s1 engineer produces circuit IDs, endpoints, device ratings, conductor details, protection selections, panel assignments, symbol types, units and design revision. Capture and engineering decisions remain counted; incomplete connections are drawn and checked manually.
OTHER means electrical CAD environment. Test native table-driven generation first; existing automatic schedules earn no new labour savings.
unknowns: Current symbol and schedule generation capabilities
research_questions: Does an independent drawing check expose reversed endpoints and stale device ratings?

already_counted.description: Input specification and final electrical checks.

incremental.description: Maintain checked symbols and drawing templates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact drawing set, circuit register and design revision; edits void acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=70 gross=30 net=22 after 8 upkeep. Zero when linked drawings already exist; 5 if only repetitive schedules and standard circuits benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish simulation inputs, model assumptions and the permitted solar system comparison cases
Perform specified simulation runs and collate generation and loss outputs
Check simulation validity and interpret efficiency tradeoffs before recommending a design option

tasks.design: Use native batch cases in the solar generation simulation environment {OTHER} to execute the engineer's specified alternatives and collate outputs. Retain model validity and efficiency interpretation in {DOCS}, with no automatic selection or installation action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interactive setup and result collation repeated across similar alternatives.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case tables and exports can replay explicit settings.
tasks.still_hard: Shading, weather representativeness and loss assumptions can dominate apparent improvements.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer checks model adequacy and rejects misleading comparisons.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated run preparation; technical recommendations remain human.

reach.learn: Use consistent weather and loss assumptions across alternatives.

evidence.claim: Batch solar simulation and result collation are model knowledge; digest simulation claims concern other approaches and are not used as a solar benchmark.

assumptions: Boundary includes engineer-operated run setup and collation, not unattended solver time, site survey acquisition or physical testing.

Engineer produces site geometry and shading version, weather file/time basis, component models, orientation, capacity, losses, case IDs, permitted variations and comparison metrics in s1. Capture and checks are counted; missing data or unsupported variants return to manual setup.
OTHER means solar generation simulation environment. Native batch functionality precedes custom code.
unknowns: Existing automatic collation and weather-data quality
research_questions: Do paired runs reproduce a manually verified case and expose inconsistent shading assumptions?

already_counted.description: Case specification and independent result interpretation.

incremental.description: Maintain reference cases and export mappings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=75 gross=25 net=17 after 8 upkeep. Zero if native batch use is already mature; 4 for a modest repeated alternative set with unchanged interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review specifications and recommend solar design changes

steps.what: Review specifications and investigate engineering or manufacturing changes against solar design objectives

tasks.design: Keep engineering specification review and change recommendations with the engineer using controlled evidence in {DOCS}. Reuse existing numerical results, while evaluating interactions, manufacturing limits and objective tradeoffs remains human work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Changes involve coupled objectives and application-specific constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing design records aid comparison without removing engineering judgement.
tasks.still_hard: An efficiency improvement can increase cost, manufacturing difficulty or reliability risk.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides which tradeoffs are acceptable and explains uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in review effort or expansion of change authority.

reach.learn: Connect design benefits to actual production limits.

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification records; it does not establish the appropriateness of a solar manufacturing change.

assumptions: Boundary is interpretation and recommendation; separately scoped simulations, drawing production and implementation receive no duplicate savings.
Engineer investigates objectives and constraints in s1; no free structured design adequacy or manufacturing feasibility flag is assumed.
Consider native requirements views first. Zero additional upkeep because no new automated workflow is proposed.
research_questions: Which recommendation assumptions can the manufacturing team independently verify?

already_counted.description: Specification review and recommendation judgement remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Engineering review remains intact; preparation savings assigned to other tasks are not counted again.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop solar design specifications and requirements

steps.what: Develop functional requirements and design criteria from site needs and engineering constraints
Assemble design specifications and requirement trace tables into the controlled document format
Check requirements completeness, consistency and testability before accepting the specification revision

tasks.design: Configure document assembly in {DOCS} from the engineer's explicit requirements register. The engineer continues to determine the criteria and checks the completed specification for omissions, contradictions and testability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Content and traceability references were repeatedly copied into specification documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native content controls and linked tables can assemble controlled engineering content.
tasks.still_hard: A complete template can still omit a critical site or operating requirement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer determines requirements and recognises missing operational conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly; requirements decisions and acceptance remain with the engineer.

reach.task: Translate functional criteria into component design
reach.learn: Make requirements measurable without prescribing unjustified solutions.

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification records; the proposed document assembly and labour estimates remain an E1 design inference.
Native assembly of specifications from explicit content records is model knowledge, not a measured role outcome.

assumptions: Boundary covers specification development and assembly; site survey execution and later detailed drawings are separately scoped.

In s1 engineer produces requirement IDs, exact statements, units, target values, tolerances, operating conditions, source references, verification methods and unresolved issues. Content capture and engineering decisions are counted; missing criteria require manual resolution rather than invented defaults.
Use native controlled templates before custom document generators.
research_questions: Can reviewers detect a missing operating condition and an untestable criterion in the assembled document?

already_counted.description: Requirement content development and final technical review.

incremental.description: Maintain document mappings and representative completeness checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact specification, requirement register and template revisions; changes void acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=75 gross=25 net=18 after 7 upkeep. Zero where specifications already derive from requirements; 4 if repeated assembly of a limited section set benefits.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated drawings, run setup and specification assembly can shrink while design decisions and independent checks remain human.
reach: Coordinate requirements with electrical engineers and production constraints with manufacturing engineers.
role.ambitious_version: A solar engineer whose repeated outputs derive from checked design records and whose recommendations remain independently reasoned.
